mapper.select: select em.name ,fou.unit_name,fop.position_name from hls_credit_line_chance_approver ca join sys_user_allocation sua on sua.allocation_id= ca.allocation_id join FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea on fea.employee_assign_id=sua.employee_assign_id join fnd_employee em on em.employee_id=fea.employee_id join fnd_org_unit fou on fou.unit_id=fea.unit_id join fnd_org_position fop on fop.position_id=fea.position_id

SELECT hclca.chance_id, hclca.approver_id, hclca.allocation_id, em.name, fou.unit_name, fop.position_name, hclca.vote_status, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.FACTORING_RESULT' AND sc.code_value = hclca.vote_status ) vote_status_n, hclca.vote_comment FROM hls_credit_line_chance_approver hclca INNER JOIN sys_user_allocation sua ON sua.allocation_id = hclca.allocation_id INNER JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea ON fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id INNER JOIN fnd_employee em ON em.employee_id = fea.employee_id INNER JOIN fnd_org_unit fou ON fou.unit_id = fea.unit_id INNER JOIN fnd_org_position fop ON fop.position_id = fea.position_id
hclca.chance_id = #{chanceId}
